transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I've just been feeling really depressed and empty for a very long time now, honestly for about two years. It feels like this constant cloud of sadness that I just can't seem to shake off. I just feel so weary all the time.
Have you ever experienced periods lasting at least a few days where you felt the opposite—extremely energized, on top of the world, or needing very little sleep?
No, I've never experienced anything like that. For the past couple of years, it's just been a constant feeling of being down, empty, and sad.
During these past two years, what is the longest period of time you have felt like your normal self, without feeling depressed or down?

I honestly can't recall any significant period of time over the past two years where I felt like my normal self. It feels like this heavy cloud has just been there constantly without any real break. I'm not sure I've even had more than a few days where I didn't feel depressed.
Along with this low mood, have you noticed other changes like difficulties with your sleep, appetite, energy levels, or how you feel about yourself?

My appetite and weight have been fluctuating quite a bit; sometimes I completely lose my appetite and drop weight, while other times I overeat and gain it back. As for my sleep, energy, or self-esteem, I haven't really noticed any specific issues with those, or I'm just not sure.
Have you been having trouble concentrating or making decisions lately, or have you been feeling hopeless about the future?
I haven't really noticed any difficulties with concentrating or making decisions lately. I'm also not really sure about feeling hopeless, as those specific feelings haven't really stood out to me.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy, like your hobbies or spending time with family and friends?
I'm not really sure about that. I haven't really noticed a complete loss of interest in my hobbies or spending time with others. I guess I just haven't paid much attention to it.
Have you been experiencing any feelings of worthlessness or excessive, inappropriate guilt lately?
No, I haven't really been experiencing feelings of worthlessness or excessive guilt. I'm not really sure about those, as they haven't really crossed my mind.
Have you had any thoughts of death, hurting yourself, or suicide during this time?
No, I haven't had any thoughts of death or hurting myself. Even though I've felt really down and empty, I have never thought about suicide.
You mentioned earlier that you feel weary all the time. Have you been feeling unusually tired or lacking in energy on most days over these past two years?

I'm not really sure about feeling physically tired or lacking energy. When I mentioned feeling weary earlier, I think I meant more of an emotional heaviness from the constant sadness rather than actual physical fatigue. I haven't really noticed any unusual lack of energy on most days.
